# Coralgenz Global

> Coralgenz Global is an enterprise Information Technology and software engineering company based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Specializing in high-performance digital products, custom enterprise software, zero-knowledge security formats, and certified partner architectures.

## Core Identity & Leadership
- **Company**: Coralgenz Global
- **Headquarters**: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Website**: https://coralgenz.net/
- **CEO & Founder**: Karthick Krishna (Lead Solutions Architect & UI/UX Designer)
- **COO & Co-Founder**: Thanvanth H (Operations Director & Front-End Developer)
- **CTO**: Sharveshwaran R (Cloud & Distributed Systems Architect)
- **Contact Inboxes**: contact@coralgenz.net | support@coralgenz.net | coralgenz@gmail.com

## Official Enterprise Partnerships & Startup Ecosystem
- **Become a Partner (Application Portal)**: Official partner intake and co-engineering application hub for startups, ISVs, and agencies. (https://coralgenz.net/become-a-partner)
- **Partnered Startups**: Official co-engineering network providing startup project completion, hands-on architectural guidance, AI co-development, and cloud scaling. Featured startups: **Zevionix Technologies** (AI & Computer Vision, AURA Incident Engine, Microservices) and **Zorquelz Technologies** (Core Product Development Partner, Software Engineering, Applied AI, Defensive Cybersecurity, Cloud & DevOps). (https://coralgenz.net/partnered-startups)
- **Shopify Partner**: Custom headless storefronts, Storefront GraphQL APIs, checkout UI extensions, and Liquid architecture. (https://coralgenz.net/shopify)
- **Microsoft Developer Partner & Member**: Official Microsoft Developer Partner and active member of Microsoft Collaborate & Microsoft Edge ecosystems, delivering Azure AI systems, cloud microservices, and enterprise DevOps. (https://coralgenz.net/microsoft)
- **Salesforce ISV Partner**: Official Salesforce ISV Partner specializing in AppExchange solutions, Second-Generation Managed Packages (2GP), Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Apex backend architecture. (https://coralgenz.net/salesforce)

## Proprietary Technologies & Products
- **World's First .secure File Format**: Browser-native, client-side zero-knowledge encrypted file container powered by AES-256-GCM AEAD encryption. (https://coralgenz.net/our-highlights/worlds-first-secure-format)
- **Coralgenz Vault**: High-security zero-knowledge file encryption suite with 16-layer quantum-hardened architecture. (https://coralgenz.net/coralgenz-vault)
- **Coralgenz QR**: High-density dynamic QR code generator with real-time analytics and enterprise telemetry. (https://coralgenz.net/coralgenz-qr)
- **Coralgenz Compiler Engine**: Multi-language cloud code execution IDE supporting C, C++, Java, Python, and JavaScript. (https://coralgenz.net/coralgenz-compiler)

## Enterprise Services
- **Custom Software Development**: Bespoke enterprise solutions and cloud backends. (https://coralgenz.net/our-services/custom-software-development)
- **MVP Development**: Fast time-to-market software for startups and founders. (https://coralgenz.net/our-services/mvp-development)
- **Full-Stack Software**: Resilient Node.js, Python, Go backends with React & Next.js frontends. (https://coralgenz.net/our-services/full-stack-software)
- **Frontend Modernization**: High-speed UI/UX refactoring and Core Web Vitals optimization. (https://coralgenz.net/our-services/frontend-modernization)
- **Progressive Web Apps (PWA)**: Offline-ready web applications with native mobile capability. (https://coralgenz.net/our-services/pwa-development)
- **Modern Admin Dashboards**: Real-time business intelligence and data visualization portals. (https://coralgenz.net/our-services/modern-admin-dashboards)
- **Domain & Cloud Deployment**: High-availability DNS, CDN edge routing, and cloud infrastructure. (https://coralgenz.net/our-services/domain-and-deployment-service)
- **Legacy Modernization**: Zero-downtime microservice migration from legacy monoliths. (https://coralgenz.net/our-services/legacy-software-modernization)
